I checked the `v2-subclass` proposal. `text-check` came back clean, and the title, the short sections and the ticked Land checklist all read clearly. The one fix was that three agents were named without links. I turned `mastermind-chat-model`, `mastermind-read-aloud-next` and `mastermind-dictation-v3` into @mentions in `requirements.md`, and logged the result as "rewrote" in `flags.jsonl`.

I didn't take screenshots, because this is a requirements file with no page.
